overview.title: Full Weekly Meal Prep Process
overview.description: A comprehensive 9-step system for efficient weekly meal preparation, designed to save time, reduce food waste, and maintain nutritional goals.

tasks.task: Define your goals: macros/calories, cost-saving, time-saving, variety, or simplicity
Decide meal scope: how many meals you're prepping for
Set weekly targets: budget, nutrition goals, time constraints

step.name: Inspiration + Recipe Selection
step.description: Discover and select recipes for the week

tasks.task: Browse sources: Instagram, Pinterest, saved Reels, cookbooks, or apps
Pick 4–6 core recipes that share ingredients
Consider variety: different proteins, cooking methods, and cuisines
Check difficulty: balance complex and simple recipes
Check existing stock: avoid duplicates and reduce waste
Cross-reference recipes: see what you already have
Note expiration dates: prioritize ingredients that need to be used soon
Create "use first" list: items approaching expiration
Auto-categorize by section
Combine quantities from multiple recipes to avoid overbuying
Tag preferences: discounted or preferred brands if budget-conscious
Add backup items: quick meal options for busy days
Use pre-built list: digital or print format
Shop strategically: follow store layout to save time
Check quality: especially for produce and proteins
Optional: Order online for convenience
Optional: Use AI agents for best local discounts
Optional: Compare prices across stores

step.name: Prep Day / Batch Cook Day
step.description: Choose 1–2 days per week for meal preparation

method.name: Full Cook Method
method.description: Cook all meals completely and store in containers

tasks.task: Chop vegetables: store in airtight containers
Marinate proteins: prepare for quick cooking later
Cook grains/starches: rice, quinoa, pasta in bulk
Pre-cook proteins: chicken, ground meat, etc.

organization_tips.tip: Label containers: meal name + preparation date
Use proper storage: microwave/oven safe, BPA-free containers
Separate components: keep sauces separate to avoid sogginess

step.name: Meal Planning Calendar
step.description: Schedule meals strategically throughout the week

scheduling_factors.factor: Freshness priority: fish early week, pasta later
Time availability: quick meals on busy days
Variety balance: different cuisines throughout week

step.name: Storage & Portioning
step.description: Proper storage for maximum freshness and convenience

tasks.task: Container selection: microwave/oven safe, BPA-free, various sizes
Proper portioning: based on nutritional goals and appetite
Sauce separation: prevent sogginess and maintain texture
Freezer strategy: freeze overflow meals for backup weeks
Labeling system: clear dates and contents for easy identification

evaluation_questions.question: What worked well? (successful recipes and processes)
What didn't work? (identify pain points and failures)

tasks.task: Recipe tracking: maintain journal or app of liked meals
Build rotation list: catalog of reliable go-to recipes
Process refinement: adjust timing, quantities, or methods

category.name: AI Integration
category.tip: Use AI to recommend recipes based on pantry inventory + macro goals
Automatically generate grocery lists with shopping links
Get personalized suggestions based on dietary restrictions

category.name: Scheduling Automation
category.tip: Build recurring schedule for planning and cooking days

category.name: Progress Tracking
category.tip: Photo documentation of meal prep sessions
Cost tracking per meal and per week
Time spent vs. time saved calculations

category.name: Cost Reduction
category.benefit: Strategic use of ingredients across multiple recipes

category.name: Stress Reduction
category.benefit: Flexible system that adapts to lifestyle changes
